what: Scored written responses from the Automated Student Assessment Prize (ASAP), 2012: 12,976 essays on 8 prompts, each scored by two trained human raters.
publisher: The William and Flora Hewlett Foundation, released for a Kaggle competition in 2012: https://www.kaggle.com/c/asap-aes
license_note: The file was released for the competition and is widely used in research. No open license is stated. This project downloads the file and does not redistribute it.
